first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests simplifying onboarding improves first-week activation and time-to-value without relying on discounting. I would verify the two onboarding records plus activation-messaging evidence before committing, then run a guarded test measuring completion, first meaningful action, qualified pipeline, and downstream retention to avoid optimizing for shallow signups.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding-shortening experiment, since onboarding completion is down 4% and the verified record shows completion improving 13%, time-to-value falling 2.1 days, and 30-day retention improving 3%. This is more sustainable than promotional pricing and avoids relying on signup simplification, whose qualified-revenue lift came with a 1% retention decline and was validated only for SMBs. Measure completion, activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and retention by segment before scaling.
